english.title: Lost Deathstalkers
english.objective: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
english.complete: You found us!  And not a moment too soon...
english.detail:
A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine.  We have not heard from them.

They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed.  Find these Deathstalkers.

Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine.  You should begin your search there.

english.title: Wild Hearts
english.objective: Gather 3 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: My time is short, <class>, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.
english.complete:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.>

It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

Let us hope that these failures are rare.

I'll give you the potion in a moment, but here is its recipe - if those Deathstalkers find themselves in need of future aid, then perhaps you can give it yourself.
english.detail:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.

429.sourceNote: Both current English references require three hearts. The older installed Questie snapshot lists six.

english.title: Return to Quinn
english.objective: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
english.progress: My sister told me you were here to aid us.  Is that true?
english.complete:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, <name>.
english.detail:
Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.

Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...

english.title: Wild Eyes
english.objective: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.complete:
The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.

However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...

<Renferrel takes the eyes.>

I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.
english.detail:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.

english.title: Return to Quinn (Again)
english.objective: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
english.progress: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
english.complete:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, <name>.
english.detail:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.

english.title: Ivar the Foul
english.objective: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.
english.progress: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
english.complete:
Ah, thank you.  You have my gratitude, <name>.

And I will include you in the report I make to my superiors.
english.detail:
My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon Silverpine Forest and report to High Executor Hadrec.  But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

We escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn.  He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.

Kill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal.  Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.

425.sourceNote: Separate quest ID in the Forever client listing and matching English public references. Live pickup prerequisite remains unverified.

english.title: The Lost Runner
english.objective: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.
english.complete: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...
english.detail:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.

english.title: Not Dead Yet
english.objective: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolanaar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
english.complete:
The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.

We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
english.detail:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...

english.title: The Great Tree Provides
english.objective: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
english.progress: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
english.complete:
Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.

Now, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.
english.detail:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.

english.title: Easing Suffering
english.objective: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
english.progress: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
english.complete: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>
english.detail:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.

english.title: A Missing Hand
english.objective: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
english.complete:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.

Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
english.detail:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.

english.title: Threat from Below
english.objective: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.
english.complete:
This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.

We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.
english.detail:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
